description: This file contains the implementation of the iScroll library, a JavaScript-based scrolling utility that enables smooth scrolling and custom scrollbars for web content, especially on mobile devices. It defines the iScroll class with methods for handling touch/mouse events, scrolling, snapping, and scrollbar management.

classes.name: iScroll
classes.description: Main class providing scrolling functionality, event handling, and scrollbar management.

classes.name: scrollbar
classes.description: Helper class for creating and managing custom scrollbars.

methods.name: iScroll
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the scrolling object with target element and options.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Recalculates dimensions and resets scroll position.

methods.name: scrollTo
methods.description: Scrolls to specified x and y coordinates with optional animation duration.

methods.name: scrollToPage
methods.description: Scrolls to a specific page or position based on page index.

methods.name: scrollToElement
methods.description: Scrolls to a specific DOM element.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes event listeners and cleans up the instance.
